what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from India in the United States: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 98011 Indian asylum seekers in the United States, 54.1% of all asylum seekers from India.
Refugees from India, a separate group, live mostly in Canada and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Kashmir territory in India from 1995 to 2025, and over the government of India from 1996 to 2025 with groups including the PWG, MCC and CPI-Maoist.
The fact pack does not link these conflicts to the asylum figures.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 4998 asylum seekers.
The figure reached its highest point, 125897, at the end of 2024, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for the United States only.
